On June 2nd, 2026, one of the most impactful updates in DonutSMP history happened. It was preluded by the server being down for ~12 hours to prepare everything for the update.

This update was highly controversial in the community due to the massive changes it introduced.

List of changes in the update:

* [[Shop]] removed
* [[Spawn]] removed
* [[Sell Multiplier]] removed
* [[Teams]] removed
* [[Duels]] removed
* [[Billford]] removed
* Donut++ and Donut+++ ranks added
* Friends added
* AFK removed
* Shards no longer granted upon killing players
* Shard Shop added to obtain items with shards, replacing Shop
* Replaced Inventory UI to Dialog UI for homes, settings, etc.
* New statistics scoreboard with expanded customization
* Non-Donut+ users now receive 3 homes instead of 2 (some ppl with team homes are lucky enough to get 4)
* Non-Donut+ users now have 18 Auction House and Orders slots instead of 25
* Teleporting with RTP or homes is now instant, instead of a 5-second delay
